output.reason: The 3.0.0 upgrade guide says the CLI flags for the compactor's shared store and path prefix "are now removed" [ev-c569cd56f9ef], and `-boltdb.shipper.compactor.shared-store.key-prefix` is one of the flags it lists [ev-cf8ca5687050]. That makes this a removed CLI flag, so the standard exposure condition fits: an environment is exposed when its workloads still pass that flag (cli-flag set). The guide also removes the matching YAML setting, `shared_store_key_prefix`, but the subject of this item is the CLI flag only, so the YAML key belongs to its own assertion and does not make this condition too narrow.
